user.title: Set up Home Status
user.description: Choose what Home Status should watch and surface. Select individual entities for precise control, whole devices when related sensors should be interpreted together, and non-device information such as weather or calendars. You can change these selections later.

data.selected_devices: Whole devices you want to monitor

data_description.selected_entities: Use this for exact control over specific sensors, binary sensors, alarms, or other entities you want Home Status to watch.
data_description.selected_devices: Use a whole device when several related entities belong together, such as a washer, dryer, dishwasher, thermostat, or similar device.
data_description.selected_sources: Choose supported information that is not primarily a device, such as weather, calendars, location, or other Home Status sources.

init.title: Home Status - Reconfiguration
init.description: Configure what Home Status monitors, how information is presented on the card, and how recent activity is retained. These settings affect Home Status only; they do not change your Home Assistant devices, entities, or Recorder history.

manage.title: Currently Monitoring
manage.description: Review the items Home Status is currently using. Select an item to change its display name or stop monitoring it.

data_description.item: Choose the monitored item you want to manage.

manage_empty.title: Currently Monitoring
manage_empty.description: Home Status is not monitoring anything yet. Add an entity, whole device, or supported information source to begin.

manage_item.title: {item_name}
manage_item.description: Choose what you want to change for {item_name}: its Home Status display name or whether Home Status continues monitoring it.

data.confirm: Yes, remove this item from Home Status

data_description.confirm: Confirmation is required because the item will be removed from Home Status monitoring.

add.title: Add Something
add.description: Add something Home Status should use. Choose an individual entity for exact control, a whole device when related entities belong together, or an information source for non-device information such as weather or calendars.

add_entities.title: Search All Entities
add_entities.description: Search the full Home Assistant entity list and select the exact entities Home Status should monitor.

data_description.entities: Select one or more individual Home Assistant entities to add to Home Status.

add_devices.title: Add a Whole Device
add_devices.description: Add a whole device when related entities should be interpreted together, such as an appliance or other multi-entity device.

data_description.devices: Select one or more whole devices to add to grouped Home Status monitoring.

add_sources.title: Add an Information Source
add_sources.description: Add supported non-device information such as weather, calendars, location, or other information sources.

data_description.sources: Select one or more supported information sources to add to Home Status.

sources.title: Information Sources
sources.description: Manage the information Home Status can surface and the generic visual sources available to Visual Center.

news_sources.title: News sources
news_sources.description: Add one generic RSS or Atom feed. Feed-provided images may appear in Visual Center only for genuinely new articles.

news_source_edit.title: RSS/Atom feed
news_source_edit.description: Configure a generic news feed. An image is used only when the feed itself supplies one.

live_news_sources.title: Live News sources
live_news_sources.description: Add Direct HTTPS HLS streams for shared, rotating Visual Center samples. These streams do not create ticker or history items.

live_news_source_edit.title: Live HLS source
live_news_source_edit.description: Configure one source for the shared Live News rotation. Higher-priority visuals take over immediately; Live News waits for its next scheduled sample.

data_description.url: Use a direct HTTPS HLS manifest URL. Home Status does not scrape or adapt publisher websites.

live_news_settings.title: Live News sampling settings
live_news_settings.description: Set one shared cadence for the whole Live News rotation. Each sample selects exactly one enabled source, then advances to the next source.

data_description.sample_interval: How long Home Status waits before selecting the next source in the rotation.
data_description.display_duration: How long the selected channel stays in Visual Center unless a higher-priority visual takes over.
data_description.mute: Keep autoplay muted. This is recommended for unattended household displays.

information_sources.title: Information sources
information_sources.description: Choose non-device information Home Status can surface, such as weather, calendars, location, and other supported sources. What appears on the card can be controlled separately under Presentation & behavior.

data_description.selected_sources: Select the information feeds Home Status may use. What appears on the card can be controlled separately under Presentation & behavior.

household_presence.title: Household presence
household_presence.description: Show one household summary such as Everyone Home, Everyone Away, or 2 of 4 Home. Select the people who belong in the household. While this is enabled, those people are grouped into one Home Status item instead of appearing separately in the card and ticker.

data_description.enabled: Turn this on to replace separate person/location items for the selected people with one combined household item.
data_description.people: Choose the Home Assistant person entities that should be counted together. Leave this empty to use all available person entities.

visual_sources.title: Visual sources
visual_sources.description: Add or edit visual content that Visual Center can show. Each source is generic: select a Home Assistant camera and the entity state that makes it available.

data_description.visual_source: Select an existing camera visual source to edit, or choose Add camera visual source.

visual_camera.title: Camera visual source
visual_camera.description: Show the selected Home Assistant camera while the selected trigger entity has the chosen state. Home Status uses Home Assistant's camera capabilities; it does not require a direct stream URL.

data_description.camera_entity_id: The Home Assistant camera to render when this source is active.
data_description.trigger_entity_id: Any Home Assistant entity whose state determines when this camera visual is available.
data_description.trigger_state: This source becomes active when the trigger entity exactly matches this state. The common default is on.
data_description.priority: Higher-priority visuals temporarily take over Visual Center and lower-priority resumable visuals may return afterward.
data_description.hold_seconds: After the trigger clears, keep this visual eligible for this many seconds. Set 0 to remove it immediately.
data_description.enabled: Turn this source off without deleting its configuration.
data_description.resumable: Keep this visual eligible again after a higher-priority visual ends.
data_description.remove_source: Remove this camera visual source when you save.

names.title: Names
names.description: Choose a monitored item and set the name people see in Home Status. The list uses friendly names; raw entity IDs and provider data are not shown.

data_description.item: Select the item whose Home Status display name you want to review or change.

name_edit.title: Display name
name_edit.description: Use the normal Home Assistant friendly name or set a custom display name for Home Status.

data_description.name_mode: Use the Home Assistant friendly name, or choose Custom name to set a different label in Home Status.
data_description.custom_name: Enter the name people should see when Custom name is selected.

timing.title: Timing & history
timing.description: Control relative timestamps such as “Just now” or “5 min ago,” how long recent completed activity stays visible, and how much Home Status event history is retained.

timestamps.name: Relative timestamps
timestamps.description: Choose which kinds of information should show an age. Relative time is useful for events such as a door closing or an appliance completing, but can make continuously valid information look stale, so each group can be controlled separately.

data_description.timestamp_contacts: Show relative time on door/window activity so people can see how recently the contact changed.
data_description.timestamp_other: Show relative time on other current/status information. Leave this off if you do not want ongoing values such as schedules or climate information to look stale.

retention.name: Retention
retention.description: Set how long recent completed activity remains available for display and how many days of Home Status event history are kept.

data_description.ticker_event_minutes: How far back Home Status reads Recorder transitions for recent activity.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Directly manage the selected entity and device lists. Most users should use Monitoring instead.

devices.title: Whole Device Selection
devices.description: Directly review the whole devices Home Status is monitoring as grouped devices.

data_description.selected_devices: Whole devices currently selected for grouped Home Status monitoring.

entities_advanced.title: Individual entity selection
entities_advanced.description: Directly review every individually selected entity Home Status is monitoring.

data_description.selected_entities: Individual entities currently selected for Home Status monitoring.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Choose what Home Status watches. Use Individual entities when you want exact control over specific Home Assistant entities, or Whole devices when Home Status should interpret related sensors from the same physical device together.

monitoring_entities.title: Individual entities
monitoring_entities.description: Select the exact entities Home Status should watch for activity, alerts, and recent events. Use this when you want precise control instead of monitoring a whole device.

data_description.selected_entities: Search your full Home Assistant entity list. Use individual selection when you want Home Status to watch exactly this entity rather than an entire device.

monitoring_devices.title: Whole devices
monitoring_devices.description: Select whole devices when related entities should be interpreted together. This is useful for appliances and other devices that expose separate state, remaining-time, completion, fault, or measurement entities.

data_description.selected_devices: Choose devices whose related entities should be interpreted together by Home Status.

presentation.title: Presentation & behavior
presentation.description: Control the Home Status card without editing YAML or raw provider data. Adjust card and text sizing, choose where different kinds of information appear, set icon colors, change display names, and control timestamps and retention. The current Home Status look is used as the starting configuration.

layout_sizing.title: Layout & sizing
layout_sizing.description: Tune card dimensions, text, secondary text, icons, and emphasized values for readability on wall tablets, desktops, and other displays.

card_dimensions.name: Card dimensions
card_dimensions.description: Control the overall space Home Status uses. Increase the body or main-row height when larger text needs more breathing room; adjust the bottom height for the ticker. Maximum width limits how wide the card may grow; 0 leaves width unrestricted by Home Status.

data_description.card_body_height: Overall height available to the main Home Status body. Increase this when the left/right content feels vertically cramped.
data_description.main_row_height: Vertical space reserved for the main left and right information items inside the card.
data_description.bottom_height: Height of the bottom ticker area. Increase this for larger ticker text and icons or reduce it for a more compact card.
data_description.card_max_width: Maximum width Home Status may use. Set to 0 to let the dashboard layout determine the width without a Home Status limit.

left_area.name: Left area
left_area.description: Set the normal typography and icon size for items shown in the left main area. These values do not control specially emphasized measurements.

data_description.left_title_size: Size of the primary headline, such as “Washer Running” or “Front Door Open.”
data_description.left_summary_size: Size of supporting text below the headline, such as remaining time, dates, or status details.
data_description.left_icon_size: Size of the icon shown beside normal left-area information.

right_area.name: Right area
right_area.description: Set the normal typography and icon size for items shown in the right main area. Weather conditions and large numeric values can use separate emphasis sizes below.

data_description.right_title_size: Size of the primary headline for normal right-area information.
data_description.right_summary_size: Size of supporting text below normal right-area headlines.
data_description.right_icon_size: Size of the icon shown beside normal right-area information.

bottom_area.name: Bottom ticker
bottom_area.description: Control the typography and icon size of the bottom ticker. The ticker often carries recent events and additional information, so it can be sized independently from the main areas.

data_description.bottom_title_size: Size of the main text for each bottom-ticker item.
data_description.bottom_summary_size: Size of supporting text in the bottom ticker, including dates, details, or relative time when enabled.
data_description.bottom_icon_size: Size of icons used in the bottom ticker.

value_emphasis.name: Value emphasis
value_emphasis.description: Use larger typography for values that should be readable at a glance, such as temperature, humidity, and other measurements. This does not enlarge every title; it only affects values Home Status recognizes as emphasis-worthy.

data_description.emphasize_measurements: When enabled, supported numeric measurements can use the larger value sizes below instead of ordinary title sizing.
data_description.left_measurement_size: Large-value text size when an emphasized measurement is shown in the left area.
data_description.right_measurement_size: Large-value text size when an emphasized measurement is shown in the right area.
data_description.right_weather_size: Text size used for the current weather condition in the right area, such as “Cloudy” or “Rainy.”
data_description.bottom_measurement_size: Large-value text size when an emphasized measurement is shown in the bottom ticker.

routing_filters.title: Routing & filters
routing_filters.description: Decide where each type of information may appear. Left and Right are the main information areas; Bottom is the scrolling/recent-activity ticker. Choose more than one destination when useful, or clear all destinations to hide that type from the card.

contacts.name: Doors & windows
contacts.description: Route active contact states separately from recent resolved activity. For example, an open door can stay prominent in a main area while a recently closed door can move to the bottom ticker.

data_description.route_doors_open: Where currently open door information may appear.
data_description.route_doors_closed: Where recent door-closed events may appear after a door has been resolved.
data_description.route_windows_open: Where currently open window information may appear.
data_description.route_windows_closed: Where recent window-closed events may appear after a window has been resolved.

appliances_and_security.name: Appliances & security
appliances_and_security.description: Control active appliance activity, completed appliance events, and security alerts independently. This lets running appliances remain visible without forcing completion events into the same area.

data_description.route_appliances_running: Where active washer, dryer, dishwasher, and other supported appliance activity may appear.
data_description.route_appliances_complete: Where recent appliance-completion events may appear after a cycle ends.
data_description.route_security: Where active security-related alerts may appear.

information.name: Information
information.description: Choose where ongoing and upcoming information is presented. These categories are informational rather than recent completed events, so many users keep them in the main left/right areas.

data_description.route_weather: Current weather conditions and supported forecast-related information.
data_description.route_climate: Temperature, humidity, and other supported climate or measurement values.
data_description.route_waste: Garbage, recycling, and other supported waste-collection information.
data_description.route_calendar: Upcoming calendar events selected under Information sources.
data_description.route_news: News items supplied by supported Home Status news/RSS sources.
data_description.route_irrigation: Sprinkler schedules, rain delay, next watering, and other supported irrigation information.
data_description.route_other: Supported information that does not match one of the specific categories above.

empty_area_behavior.name: Empty-area behavior

data.fill_empty_left: Fill an empty left area with another useful item

data_description.fill_empty_left: When enabled, Home Status may place another eligible useful item in an otherwise empty left area so half of the card is not left blank.

empty_area_behavior.description: Control what Home Status does when the left main area has nothing assigned to it. This is a presentation fallback, not a new monitoring rule.

navigation.title: Tap destinations
navigation.description: Choose what happens when someone taps an ordinary Home Status item in the main areas or bottom ticker. You can send each kind of information to one of your existing dashboard pages, open the item’s Home Assistant details, or leave it untouched. Feed headlines that already link to their article keep that article link.

enable_navigation.name: Enable page navigation
enable_navigation.description: Turn this off to leave ordinary Home Status items on their normal Home Assistant details behavior.

data.navigation_enabled: Open selected dashboard pages when items are tapped

data_description.navigation_enabled: When enabled, a configured destination opens for that kind of item. Items without a destination continue to open their usual Home Assistant details.

custom_paths.name: Custom page paths
custom_paths.description: Only used for categories set to Use custom page path above. Enter a Home Assistant path beginning with /, for example /dashboard-tablet/security.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Home Status uses icon colors to distinguish categories and important states at a glance. These settings affect icons, not text or card backgrounds.

color_behavior.name: Color behavior
color_behavior.description: Turn Home Status category coloring on or off. With category colors enabled, icons can use different colors to visually distinguish weather, appliances, waste, calendar items, and other information.

data_description.semantic_colors: Enable the category and alert/completion color choices below. Turn this off if you prefer Home Status to use its normal/default icon treatment instead.

category_colors.name: Category colors
category_colors.description: Choose the icon color associated with each normal information category. Category color answers “what kind of information is this?” and helps repeated item types stay visually consistent across the card.

data_description.color_appliance: Icon color for active washer, dryer, dishwasher, and other supported appliance information.
data_description.color_weather: Icon color for current weather and weather-related information.
data_description.color_climate: Icon color for temperature, humidity, and other climate/measurement information.
data_description.color_waste: Icon color for garbage and general waste-collection information.
data_description.color_recycling: Icon color for recycling collection information.
data_description.color_calendar: Icon color for calendar events and schedule-style information.
data_description.color_irrigation: Icon color for sprinkler, watering, rain-delay, and irrigation information.
data_description.color_news: Icon color for supported news items.

event_colors.name: Alert & completion colors
event_colors.description: Choose colors that describe what happened rather than what category an item belongs to. These can highlight attention/warning states and completed or resolved events.

data_description.color_attention: Used when Home Status presents an item as needing attention or warning.
data_description.color_success: Used for completed or resolved activity, such as a finished appliance cycle when the completion style applies.

visual_center.title: Visual Center
visual_center.description: Control whether Home Status may show the current generic visual winner between the existing left and right areas. It takes no space when no valid visual is available.

data.visual_center_enabled: Show Visual Center when visual content is available

data_description.visual_center_enabled: When enabled, the highest-priority valid visual source can appear in the center. Turn this off to keep the card in its normal two-column layout.

error.confirm_remove: Check the confirmation box before removing this item.
error.invalid_hls_url: Enter a direct HTTPS HLS URL ending in .m3u8.
error.custom_page_must_start_with_slash: Custom page paths must begin with /.

abort.no_selected_items: Home Status is not monitoring anything yet. Add something first, then you can change its name.
